package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
)

func main() {
	h := gallery.New()
	type response struct { Path string; Status int; Header map[string][]string; Body string }
	var responses []response
	for _, period := range []string{"2026-08", "2026-09"} {
		for _, group := range []string{"all", "api", "worker"} {
			for _, state := range []string{"complete", "missing", "stale", "partial"} {
				for _, theme := range []string{"light", "dark"} {
					for _, endpoint := range []string{"/analytics/recipe", "/analytics/recipe/export.csv", "/analytics/recipe/table.csv"} {
						path := fmt.Sprintf("%s?period=%s&category=%s&state=%s&theme=%s&compare=none", endpoint, period, group, state, theme)
						w := httptest.NewRecorder()
						h.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest("GET", path, nil))
						responses = append(responses, response{path,w.Code,w.Header(),w.Body.String()})
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/static/app.css", nil))
	responses = append(responses, response{"/static/app.css",w.Code,w.Header(),w.Body.String()})
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(responses); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
